project_title: Si-Scoring Kelembagaan Perangkat Daerah Kalimantan Tengah
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a high-craft Indonesian Government Institutional Evaluation & Scoring Web Application (Si-Scoring Kalteng) based on Permendagri 18/2016 & Permendagri 99/2018. Support 4 distinct role perspectives with seamless JWT session simulation: Admin, Verifikator, Penilai, and Perangkat Daerah. The design must embody modern executive govtech elegance—deep emerald slate backgrounds, gold/amber accents, high-contrast typography, and tactile data dense panels. NEVER use generic centered layouts or plain Inter headers. Ensure all interactive components have proper data-testid attributes.

anti_ai_slop_rules: Avoid default Vercel-style blue gradients or generic centered forms.
Never use pure #000000 or #808080 - tint all neutral greys with emerald/blue tones.
Headings must use Plus Jakarta Sans or Cabinet Grotesk; body uses IBM Plex Sans.
Use 2-3x generous spacing for container cards and high-density grid layouts.
All interactive elements, inputs, buttons, filter tabs, modal triggers, and scoring sliders MUST have unique data-testid attributes in kebab-case.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.hover_contrast_rule: Always explicitly specify hover text colors. Example: hover:bg-emerald-900 hover:text-white. Hover state colors must be visually distinct and pass high contrast tests.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attribute: Every interactive and dynamic element must contain data-testid (e.g. data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='score-slider-var-1', data-testid='verification-approve-btn').

capabilities: Manage users & roles (Add, Edit, Lock, Reset Pass)
Set evaluation period window & lock status (max 1 month window)
Global executive dashboard & region-wise radar comparison
Select Area (Kabupaten/Kota in Kalimantan Tengah like Palangka Raya, Kotawaringin Barat, etc.)
Specify Device Name (e.g. Dinas Kominfo, Bappeda, Dinas Kesehatan)
Upload document evidence for each of 11 variables
View status timeline & rejection revision notes from Verifikator
View final maturity score report once scored
Review uploaded evidence documents per variable
Approve verification OR reject with explicit revision notes
Rejection sends submission back to Perangkat for re-upload and restarts verification loop
Filter queue by Region, Perangkat Daerah, status
Score each of the 11 variables on a 1.0 to 5.0 scale with qualitative notes
Auto-calculates total score (11.0 to 55.0) and assigns maturity classification
Finalize and release score to Perangkat Daerah view

component_structure.src/App.js: Main layout, role context switcher / JWT login handler, navigation bar, router
component_structure.src/components/Navbar.js: Top nav with active evaluation period countdown banner, user profile, role pill, role quick switcher for demo
component_structure.src/components/RoleSwitcher.js: Quick multi-role switcher widget for testing (Admin, Verifikator, Penilai, Perangkat Daerah)
component_structure.src/components/dashboards/AdminDashboard: Executive overview, region heatmaps, period locking controls, user management modal, indicator manager
component_structure.src/components/dashboards/PerangkatDashb: Submission creation form, 11-variable document uploader, status stepper, rejection notes alert, final report card
component_structure.src/components/dashboards/VerifikatorDas: Incoming verification queue, document previewer, approve/reject modal with mandatory feedback notes
component_structure.src/components/dashboards/PenilaiDashboa: Verified scoring queue, 1-5 rating sliders per variable, automated score calculation engine, submission summary
component_structure.src/components/reports/MaturityReportCar: Downloadable/printable formal evaluation result certificate with 11-variable radar chart and recommendations
component_structure.src/components/charts/YearlyComparisonCh: Recharts line/bar chart showing multi-year maturity progression for regions and devices in Central Kalimantan
